description: An abstract Java class defining a map operation within the OFBiz minilang framework, handling error messaging and requiring subclasses to implement execution logic.

classes.name: SimpleMapOperation
classes.description: An abstract class representing a single operation on a field, with error handling and messaging capabilities.

methods.name: SimpleMapOperation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation based on XML element configuration and process context.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field this operation targets.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds an error or informational message to the messages list, supporting property-based internationalization.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Abstract method to execute the operation, to be implemented by subclasses.
